paragraphs: If your CLK 200 is a C209 generation model (2002–2009) with the M271 4-cylinder petrol engine, timing chain stretch and balance shaft issues are a well-documented pattern on this engine. We replace the timing chain, timing gears and gaskets as standard on every M271 rebuild.
The earlier C208 generation (1997–2003) uses the M111 engine, which doesn't share the same documented pattern — timing chain wear on that engine isn't independently confirmed to the same degree.
warning.source: Source: established Mercedes specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-clk.md. M111 explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to generation
